item.title: Saputo USA launches three new products
item.description: Saputo portion control (PC) creamers, and Saputo mozzarella &amp; smoked gouda cheese blend were introduced at the International Pizza Expo.

item.title: Sargento named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies
item.description: At the center of this year's recognition is the company's latest breakthrough Sargento Natural American Sliced Cheese, according to Sargento.

item.title: Hudsonville debuts Dirt Cake Ice Cream
item.description: Other new flavors from Hudsonville Ice Cream this spring are Brownie Sundae, a rich vanilla ice cream with chocolate brownie chunks, rainbow sprinkles and a delicious fudge swirl, and Fruit Smoothie Bars, made with a refreshing blend of strawberry, orange and mango fruit sherbets and inspired by Tropical Twist, a former summer Limited Edition flavor.

item.title: JonnyPops expands to 1,800 Albertsons stores
item.description: This rollout marks another milestone for JonnyPops as the brand continues expanding its distribution on the East and West Coasts.

item.title: Chobani announces $567M La Colombe Michigan plant expansion
item.description: The announcement comes at a pivotal moment as demand surges for La Colombe's signature ready-to-drink lattes, according to Chobani.

item.title: Hellmann's parent company to merge food business with McCormick
item.description: Former Ben & Jerry's parent company Unilever PLC and McCormick & Co. Inc. entered into an agreement to combine Unilever’s Foods business with McCormick.

item.title: Tetra Pak breaks ground on new Texas facility
item.description: It will enhance Tetra Pak’s ability to support food and beverage brands as they ideate, formulate, launch and scale innovative products with greater speed and efficiency.

item.title: Yasso launches Foolproof Freezer campaign
item.description: The frozen snack brand is joining forces with Bethenny Frankel, better-for-you entrepreneur and certified nonsense detector, to call out freezer fraud once and for all. Together, they're launching Foolproof Freezer, a bold campaign that's filling freezers all month long with 40,001 (a not-so-subtle nod to April Fools' Day, 4/1) creamy, craveworthy, protein-packed Yasso Spoonables that actually deliver on taste and nutrition.

item.title: USDA awards $2.99M grant to Auburn University Hunger Solutions Institute
item.description: The award includes 75 new HFMI locations in Arkansas, Georgia, Kansas, Minnesota, and Oklahoma, along with the renewal of 94 existing sites in Alabama, California, and South Dakota.

item.title: FDA approval of Eli Lilly GLP-1 pill could be big for dairy processors
item.description: Foundayo will be available via LillyDirect, with prescriptions accepted immediately and shipping beginning April 6, followed shortly after by broad availability through U.S. retail pharmacies and telehealth providers, the company said.

item.title: Episode 63 — What is the future of frozen cottage cheese?
item.description: Drew DiSpirito and Joe Rotondo, founders of Smearcase, join Dairy Foods for Episode 63 of the Let’s Talk Dairy podcast to discuss Smearcase and frozen cottage cheese, also known as FroCo.

item.title: Nelson-Jameson makes big investment in cold storage and logistics
item.description: The Fairview cold storage expansion supports Nelson-Jameson's sustainability goals.

item.title: Cargill wins 2026 BIG Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award
item.description: Cargill announced it has been named a winner in the 2026 BIG AI Awards, presented by the Business Intelligence Group, recognizing the company’s leadership and innovation in applying artificial intelligence to transform the global food and agriculture system.

item.title: Swoon unveils new lemonade with magnesium
item.description: Swoon is building on its zero-sugar portfolio with Swoonberry Lemonade, a delicious and refreshing drink with magnesium to support a balanced metabolism.

item.title: Milk scores a golden goal versus plant-based beverages
item.description: Fluid milk outperformed its main rival, plant-based beverages, in 2025. While fluid milk sales remained steady, plant-based drink sales fell 6% YoY to 358.4 million gallons. The Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act seeks to boost milk sales in schools, highlighting traditional milk's nutritional benefits amid competition.
